subject: Discovery recap: Observability + evals - dashboards, tracing, golden prompts, rollout guardrails
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability + evals - dashboards, tracing, golden prompts, rollout guardrails

Hi Sana -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're aligned. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points
- Hard to detect prompt/regression-quality drops early; current monitoring is mostly surface-level metric alerts (errors, latency) but not semantic/regression-aware.
- Lack of end-to-end tracing from user action -> model response makes root cause for degraded outputs noisy to diagnose.
- Eval coverage is sparse: no canonical golden prompts or regression alerting tied to deployments.

Current stack you shared
- App telemetry: Datadog for metrics/traces (partial instrumentation)
- Error tracking: Sentry
- Model hosting: internal cluster using a mix of open checkpoints (batched inference)
- CI: GitHub Actions; releases every 2 weeks

Success criteria for a pilot (what you said)
1) Detect major quality regressions within 30 minutes of rollout (golden prompts + regression alerts).
2) Dashboard(s) that map customer-facing features -> model-level metrics (per-route latency, token cost, top-k failures).
3) Tracing hooks that let your infra team tie a user request to model execution path and caching behavior.
4) Safe rollout guardrails (canary, automatic rollback conditions based on quality metrics)

What Redwood can deliver for the pilot
- Golden prompt set + eval harness (we'll start with ~150 prompts across 3 primary flows) and continuous regression alerts.
- Prebuilt dashboards (Datadog/Looker-style JSON exports) showing per-route latency, token-level cost, regression trends, and coverage heatmaps.
- Tracing hooks and a recommended instrumentation guide to tie user request IDs into Redwood traces; examples for Datadog/OpenTelemetry.
- Canary rollout policy template: baseline model variant -> canary (10%) -> evaluate golden prompts -> auto-promote or auto-rollback.

Attachments: I attached an MVP-eval-plan.xlsx (scope + timelines) and the redwood-observability-playbook.pdf with example dashboards and recommended tracing hooks.

Proposed next steps
- Action: I'll share the MVP eval plan and a sample golden prompt set by EOD tomorrow (9/8).
- Action: Your team to confirm a POC environment and point-of-contact for instrumentation (Sana or Amit?).
- Action: Schedule a 60-minute technical onboarding with your infra & SRE (suggest Wed 9/9 or Thu 9/10).

If this looks right I'll open a short HubSpot task and calendar invite. Thanks again - excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: MVP-eval-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-observability-playbook.pdf (PDF)]
From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@zenhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 17:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability + evals - dashboards, tracing, golden prompts, rollout guardrails

Hi Marissa -

This is an excellent summary - thank you. A few clarifications from our side:
- Instrumentation POC: Amit will be the primary contact for SRE/infra work.
- Golden prompts: We can start with the triage flows (claims intake, triage summary, policy lookup) - those are the highest-impact.
- Alerting windows: 30 minutes is fine for major regressions; can we also include a lower-severity 6-hour trend alert for drift?

Next steps from our side
- Amit will confirm available windows for technical onboarding (prefer 9/9 morning PST).
- I'll share an internal doc listing the 3 priority flows and sample user IDs for tracing.

Looking forward to the MVP materials.

Thanks,
Sana Kapoor
Head of Product, ZenHealth
Sana.Kapoor@zenhealth.com

3) I'll upload the MVP-eval-plan and sample prompts to the shared Drive and send the calendar invite once Amit confirms.

- Golden-prompt regression delta > 5% within 30 minutes OR
- Top-level user-facing accuracy metric drop > 3% sustained for 3 consecutive evaluation windows

I'll aim to share a first draft by EOD 9/10. Vivek - I'll sync with you on the tracing examples and whether we should recommend a 4-bit quantization profile for their mid-size models to reduce token cost.

Thanks,
Rishi
